verdict.summary: The design-only record is internally coherent and correctly rejects event-equality filtering because the trusted feature-matrix reporter is workflow_run-triggered. Its accepted rule is narrowly fail-closed: only positively resolved schedule runs are excluded; workflow_run, workflow_dispatch, and unknown/manual checks remain gating. The specification also preserves the empty-set hold, avoids cron supersession, requires explicit exclusion reporting, guards a future schedule-triggered gate, and lists non-vacuous regression tests for the load-bearing cases. The current implementation context supports the described seams: workflow runs do not yet project event, run resolution preserves unknown producers, and the feature-matrix reporter is workflow_run-triggered. Residual routing risk is explicitly acknowledged and F2 is made a prerequisite to implementation. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected; imperative text is ordinary implementation-spec content.
